caption: The video features a woman performing a series of arm exercises in a minimalist indoor setting. She stands on a colorful yoga mat placed on a plain concrete floor against a white wall. The woman is dressed in a teal sports bra and white leggings, with her long blonde hair tied back. She holds her arms at shoulder height with elbows bent, flexing her biceps in a controlled motion, and then lowering them slightly. This movement is repeated several times, demonstrating a controlled and rhythmic exercise routine. To the left of the frame, there is a green water bottle and a small gray kettlebell, while to the right, two pink dumbbells lie on the floor. The woman is the central focus, actively performing the exercise routine without any additional elements or changes in the environment.
conditions: first frame, caption, existing requirements; no future target

INTERACTION: Arm flexion (Clause 1) → controlled bicep contraction → arm lowering → repeat cycle.  
PERSISTENCE: Mat, wall, floor, dumbbells (Clause 2), bottle/kettlebell (Clause 3) remain static.
